== Summary ==
Unidentified players in the gaming room (including a standing player with receding hair, long back hair, short beard, and a black sleeveless metal tank top, same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship tournament room 1.jpg]] and #22 in [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]; the player in a FIGRIN D'AN shirt; the player in an orange CANTINA-style tee looking down at a paper; and the seated player in a light plaid shirt, seen from behind).

Players in the gaming room during the [[2024 World Championship]].
